title: PhysiologicalAssessment
description: Structured physiological state produced by the local model (syncfit-core) and consumed by the reasoning layer to design the routine.

k_load_multiplier.description: Deterministic load multiplier from syncfit-core. Never recomputed by the reasoning layer.

autonomic_status.description: Qualitative autonomic interpretation, e.g. BALANCED, PARASYMPATHETIC_WITHDRAWAL, SYMPATHETIC_DOMINANT.

contraindicated_patterns.description: Movement patterns to avoid given symptoms/phase.
